claims.text: The hotel is a design-led lifestyle hotel inside a restored Art Deco landmark, a few steps from Wenceslas Square and the Old Town.

findings.quote: a design led lifestyle hotel inside a restored _**Art Deco**_ landmark
just a few steps from Wenceslas Square and the Old Town

claims.text: The hotel was formerly the historic Alcron Hotel.

findings.quote: Almanac X Alcron Prague, formerly the historic Alcron Hotel

claims.text: The name Alcron comes from the initial letters of founder Alois Krofta's name, with inspiration from the mythical Greek ship Alcron.

findings.quote: its name crafted from the initial letters of his own name—ALois KROfta—while drawing inspiration from the mythical Greek ship Alcron

claims.text: Jazz legends Louis Armstrong and Ella Fitzgerald stayed at the hotel.

findings.quote: Jazz legends Louis Armstrong and Ella Fitzgerald found their haven here.

claims.text: The interior design is by the Spanish studio Tres Cinco Uno in collaboration with the Czech Marani Studio.

findings.quote: The unique interior design was masterminded by the Spanish creative studio Tres Cinco Uno in collaboration with the Czech Marani Studio.

claims.text: The original rare wood paneling, marble details and historic fireplace were preserved in the lobby and restaurant.

findings.quote: The original rare wood paneling, marble details, and the historic fireplace were all carefully preserved in the lobby and restaurant.

claims.text: The room color palette reflects Prague: sandy tones of historic stone facades, the brick red of the Old Town's terracotta roofs, and green for the city's parks and gardens.

findings.quote: The color palette of our rooms is a direct tribute to Prague?
The interiors embrace you with the sandy tones of historic stone facades. These are complemented by a brick red that mirrors the terracotta roofs of the Old Town
a calming green representing the lush greenery of Prague’s parks and gardens

claims.text: Almanac X Alcron Prague has been awarded One MICHELIN Key by the MICHELIN Guide.

findings.quote: Almanac X Alcron Prague has been awarded One MICHELIN Key by the MICHELIN Guide

claims.text: The hotel's staircase features rotating art exhibitions.

findings.quote: Our iconic staircase features rotating exhibitions.

claims.text: The hotel has a sauna and a fitness center.

findings.quote: complimentary access to the sauna and fitness center

claims.text: Studio Qubus turned the Alcron Bar into a 'Liquid Gallery', an art space filled with objects by designer Jakub Berdych Karpelis.

findings.quote: Studio Qubus transforms the Alcron Bar into a liquid gallery
Enjoy our exclusive signature drinks in this art space filled with objects by Jakub Berdych Karpelis.

claims.text: Brasserie 1932 serves Czech cuisine, brasserie-style.

findings.quote: Discover the best of Czech cuisine, brasserie-style.

claims.text: Every room and suite has unique original artworks.

findings.quote: Every room and suite harbors unique original works that perfect the unmistakable character and genius loci of each space.

claims.text: A monumental mural by Czech artist Lu Skrivankova sits right behind the reception.

findings.quote: right behind the reception, a monumental mural by Czech artist Lu Skřivánková captures everyone’s attention

claims.text: The Presidential Suite offers a view of Prague Castle.

findings.quote: Experience a two-night stay in the Presidential Suite, offering a breathtaking view of Prague Castle.

claims.text: The Presidential Suite is adorned with hand-cut crystal objects from the Ruckl glassworks, and a stay package adds a visit to the manufactory to try glassmaking.

findings.quote: our Presidential Suite is adorned with hand-cut crystal objects from the legendary Rückl glassworks. With our special stay package, you can combine luxurious accommodation with an exclusive visit to the manufactory
try the craft of glassmaking for yourself

claims.text: On the night of August 20, 1968, an Associated Press reporter sent the world's first urgent dispatch announcing the Warsaw Pact occupation of Czechoslovakia from the hotel teletype.

findings.quote: The most dramatic night, however, came on August 20, 1968
Czech-speaking reporter Petr Rehak from the Associated Press
sent the world’s very first urgent dispatch via the hotel teletype, announcing that Czechoslovakia was being occupied by Warsaw Pact troops

claims.text: The Alcron Rooftop terrace is not open yet; the hotel gives its planned opening as 2026.

findings.quote: **Planned opening is 2026.**
We can’t wait to open our rooftop terrace!

claims.text: The Alcron restaurant held a Michelin star until 2017; the hotel's current recognition is One MICHELIN Key.

findings.quote: a prestigious Michelin star, which the restaurant held until 2017
Almanac X Alcron Prague has been awarded One MICHELIN Key by the MICHELIN Guide
